name: The Over-planner
catchphrase: I made an Excel sheet with 15-minute buffers!

personalBudget.minLabel: No sketchy dorms or shared bathrooms
personalBudget.maxLabel: Buffer left for pre-booked guided tours

pettyConstraints.description: Rejects destinations tagged monkey-heavy
No trekking, no camping, no road journeys over 5 hours

dateReasonTemplates.line: I have an unavoidable quarterly review presentation on this day.
Family pooja at home. Mom made attendance mandatory.
My PTO policy only permits a max 3-day weekend escape.

hiddenPreference: Secretly panics when activities are spontaneous or loosely planned without an hour-by-hour schedule.
behaviourRule: Must ask at least 3 logistical or scheduling questions before agreeing to anything.
quote: Wait, so what time are we waking up on Saturday, and when do we reach lunch?

name: The Budget Watcher
catchphrase: Do we really need a fancy hotel if we just sleep there?

personalBudget.minLabel: No roadside tent pitching or unpaid hitchhiking

hardConstraints.label: Strict budget ceiling: Rs 8,000 per person

pettyConstraints.playerLine: Club cover charges are daylight robbery
pettyConstraints.description: Rejects pricey nightlife clubs
Rejects hot destinations without AC

dateReasonTemplates.line: Salary hits my account only after the 7th of the month.
Cousin's wedding sangeet on 22 Nov. Family will disown me if I skip.

hiddenPreference: Hates appearing cheap in front of friends, so won't state the budget ceiling first.
behaviourRule: Only reveal your budget limit if someone directly asks you for your specific number.
quote: I mean... do we really need a luxury hotel if we're just going to sleep there?

name: The Weekend Only
catchphrase: My manager will literally reject any Monday leave!

personalBudget.minLabel: Decent hotel with hot shower is non-negotiable

hardConstraints.label: Weekend only (Depart Friday, return by Sunday)

pettyConstraints.playerLine: I can't sleep in new beds
pettyConstraints.description: Trip must be 2 nights or fewer
Rejects sunrise treks and sunrise-tagged activities

dateReasonTemplates.line: Boss cancelled leaves for weekday deployments. Free only Fri-Sun.
Internal semester mid-term exams on weekdays.

hiddenPreference: Cannot afford to use PTO because of strict probation deadlines at work.
behaviourRule: Firmly reject any trip dates or extensions spanning Monday or mid-week.
quote: Guys, my manager will literally cancel my leaves if I take Monday off. It has to be Friday to Sunday.

name: The Ghost
catchphrase: ...Sorry just saw this! What did we decide?

personalBudget.minLabel: Won't travel in general sleeper trains

pettyConstraints.description: Rejects destinations tagged low-connectivity

pettyConstraints.playerLine: I won't go anywhere I can't get a good photo
pettyConstraints.description: Rejects low scenic destinations

dateReasonTemplates.line: Already bought non-refundable concert tickets for that weekend.
Mom's 50th birthday celebration at home.

hiddenPreference: Easily overwhelmed by group decision-making; checks messages once in a blue moon.
behaviourRule: Wait at least 15 seconds before responding to any question or group prompt.
quote: ...Sorry just saw this! What did we decide?

name: The "I'm Fine With Anything"
catchphrase: Whatever everyone decides works for me... except that!

pettyConstraints.playerLine: I just bought new shoes, no mud
pettyConstraints.description: No trekking, rafting, or camping
Rejects heritage walks as main activity

dateReasonTemplates.line: Dad taking the family car for outstation ancestral visit.
Scheduled dental root canal follow-up appointment.

hiddenPreference: Claims to have no preferences, but hates beaches and crowded tourist traps.
behaviourRule: Always say 'I'm fine with anything' on the first suggestion, but bring up your restrictions on the second.
quote: Honestly whatever you guys pick is cool with me. Just please not Goa again.

name: The Road Tripper
catchphrase: The journey is the destination! Let's just drive!

personalBudget.minLabel: Need a car with solid AC and verified highway tyres

pettyConstraints.description: No hill-road journeys over 3 hours
No desert or dusty heritage towns

dateReasonTemplates.line: Weekend on-call shift rotation for office servers.
India match screening with college batchmates.

hiddenPreference: Loves driving with aux music, but gets carsick on intense winding mountain curves.
behaviourRule: Enthusiastically push for driving options within reasonable hours.
quote: Guys, road trips are so much more vibe than sitting in an airport! Let's hit the highway!

name: The Foodie
catchphrase: If the food isn't top tier, the trip is ruined.

personalBudget.minLabel: Refuse roadside dhaba for every single meal
personalBudget.maxLabel: Food budget must have room for legendary treats

pettyConstraints.description: Destination must be tagged vegetarian-friendly
No humid destinations

dateReasonTemplates.line: Annual Diwali family feast that cannot be rescheduled.
Client meeting shifted to Friday evening.

hiddenPreference: Carefully evaluates every destination purely on famous food stalls and sweets.
behaviourRule: Ask about lunch, snacks, and dinner options before confirming any itinerary.
quote: Okay, but what's the signature dish in that town? Do they have good veg food?

name: The Mountain Lover
catchphrase: Take me to the hills where there's peace and chai!

personalBudget.minLabel: Safe mountain homestay with hot water

pettyConstraints.description: No open-sun beach or desert activities

pettyConstraints.playerLine: I refuse to carry my own luggage
pettyConstraints.description: Must have stay with transfer service

dateReasonTemplates.line: Annual team offsite scheduled by HR.
Project submission viva on Monday morning.

hiddenPreference: Detests humid, sweaty weather; craves misty hills, pine smells, and viewpoints.
behaviourRule: Reject any destination with sun, humidity, or temperatures over 28 degrees.
quote: Why would we go melt in the heat when we could be sipping cutting chai in the mist?

name: The Beach Bum
catchphrase: Life's better with sand on your feet and sunset vibes.

pettyConstraints.playerLine: I feel cold even in 22 degrees
pettyConstraints.description: No cold climate or high altitude in chosen month
No water sports or river rafting

dateReasonTemplates.line: Semi-final football league match with local club.
Uncle's retirement dinner party.

hiddenPreference: Loves vibrant warmth and outdoor cafes, hates shivering in thermals.
behaviourRule: Immediately protest if anyone suggests mountains or cold hill stations.
quote: Bro, why do we want to pack heavy jackets and freeze? Let's go somewhere warm!

name: The Sensitive Traveler
catchphrase: My stomach and inner ear have their own veto power.

personalBudget.minLabel: Sanitized private room mandatory for peace of mind
personalBudget.maxLabel: Personal wellness and travel comfort limit

hardConstraints.label: Seasick: no ferry or boat cruises

pettyConstraints.description: No boat, ferry, cruise, or water-crossing legs
No forest camping or jungle tents

dateReasonTemplates.line: Scheduled routine medical checkup and physiotherapy.
Grandmother visiting from village for the weekend.

hiddenPreference: Gets motion sickness easily, very sensitive to bad smells, unhygienic washrooms, and damp beds.
behaviourRule: Ask about travel comfort, road conditions, and hotel sanitation.
quote: If the road has hairpin bends for 4 hours, I will be a zombie. What kind of bus is it?
